key_insight: A planner-executor multimodal AI system can answer many lung cancer screening CT patient questions while also deciding when to defer to a physician.
clinical_relevance: This could help improve patient understanding of screening results and support follow-up communication in lung cancer screening programs.
method: Used 116 lung cancer screening CT reports and images from a tertiary academic hospital.
Generated 699 simulated patient questions, split into answerable vs defer-to-doctor cases.
Evaluated tool-calling, self-regulation, and physician-rated clinical quality.
evidence_signal: The system achieved 93.1% tool-calling accuracy and 92.6% self-regulation accuracy, with strong physician-rated scores for clinical accuracy and understandability.
watch_item: Results came from simulated questions and a retrospective dataset, so real-world performance, safety, and workflow integration still need prospective validation.
paper_title: Planner-Executor Style Multimodal Agentic System to Answer Patient Questions in Lung Cancer Screening CT
